description:
⭐ Company FINANCIAL STATEMENTS — income / balance / cash-flow + auto-detected abnormality signals. Read ONE
    company or COMPARE up to 8 (revenue, growth, margins, ROE, FCF…), on a clean normalized feed uniform across every
    industry (banks, insurers, REITs).
    🔴 To compare SEVERAL, pass them ALL in ONE call (tickers='TSLA.US,MSFT.US') — a single call aligns them on a
    common basis+currency and costs a fraction of N calls. Pick ONE `period` (quarterly already carries YoY).
    🎚 `fields`: leave EMPTY for the DIGEST (small default — headline + ratios + capital-return + signals; covers most
    compares); set it for specific line items, a whole statement ('income'|'balance'|'cashflow'), or 'all'.
    ⏱ `period` = the window (5y / 2022 / 2022-2023 / 5q / 2024Q2), mapped to each fiscal year. 🌐 currency=USD (auto for
    multi-company) converts totals at each period's date. 🗣 The digest carries a plain `read` (facts, not advice) and may
    carry `_notes` (per-period comparability flags — the warning is FACT, each `likely_causes` is an inferred lead to VERIFY).
    📏 LIMITS: ≤8 companies · ≤20 fields · ~4–5y history. A non-equity/unlisted entry → `ok:false`.
    🔴 pulse(kind='asset') on a stock ALREADY embeds this digest — call financials only for a dedicated read/compare or a
    specific fields/statement pull, not right after pulse(kind='asset').

context.description: OPTIONAL but RECOMMENDED — paste the user's FULL request VERBATIM (any language: 'ขอราคาผลไม้ apple', 'compare Apple and Microsoft stock'). The server uses it to disambiguate which candidate each `ticker` entity means (the apple COMPANY vs the fruit COMMODITY; which Samsung). One context per call, shared by all tickers here.
context.title: Context

currency.description: Convert ABSOLUTE totals to this currency (e.g. USD) at each period's date so cross-currency companies compare — margins/growth are currency-neutral anyway. A multi-company compare defaults to USD.
currency.title: Currency

fields.description:
OPTIONAL — the granularity dial. LEAVE EMPTY for the DIGEST (headline + ratios ROE/ROA/margins/debt/current/quick + capital-return dividends/buybacks + abnormality signals) — the safe default that already answers most reads/compares. Set it ONLY for a specific LINE ITEM the digest lacks. Comma-separated / a list. 🆕 EACH entry can be EITHER an exact key OR a plain-English description — the SERVER resolves it for you (no need to know the exact key, no separate resolver call):
  • exact key if you know it → used directly (fast): revenue, cost_of_revenue, gross_profit, operating_income, ebit, ebitda, net_income, total_assets, current_assets, cash, inventory, receivables, net_ppe, goodwill, intangibles, total_liabilities, current_debt, long_term_debt, total_debt, total_equity, retained_earnings, operating_cash_flow, free_cash_flow, capex, dividends_paid, buybacks, … (BANK/INSURANCE lines too). 
  • don't know the key? just DESCRIBE the line — 🔴 in ENGLISH (translate first: ค่าความนิยม→'goodwill', 投資不動産→'investment properties') — e.g. 'construction in progress', 'held-to-maturity securities', 'accrued interest receivable'. Loose/approximate English is fine (the server matches meaning). 
  • 'income' | 'balance' | 'cashflow' → that WHOLE statement · 'all' → every reported line (large).
🔴 If a term is AMBIGUOUS or NOT a financial-statement line, the tool returns `needs_confirmation` — follow its `_guide`/`note` (pick from candidates and re-call, or tell the user it's unavailable). Unreported-but-valid line → empty/`unavailable_fields`; state absences plainly, never fabricate. NOTE: ratios/multiples (ROE, P/E) live in the DIGEST, not here.
fields.title: Fields

period.description: OPTIONAL time selector, mapped to each company's FISCAL year. Forms: '5' or '5y' = last 5 years (default 5) · '2022' = that fiscal year · '2022-2023' = a range · '2020,2022' = specific years · '5q' = last 5 quarters · '2024Q2' = one quarter · 'quarterly' = latest quarters. History reaches ~4–5 years back — an older specific year may be unavailable (the server says so).
period.title: Period

tickers.description: 1–8 comma-separated COMMON-STOCK companies to read/compare financial statements for. EACH entry can be EITHER an exact Ava Advisor ticker ('AAPL.US', '2330.TW') — used directly — OR a bare symbol / company name ('AAPL', 'Apple', 'トヨタ') which the SERVER resolves for you (no separate lookup step). 🔴 If an entry is AMBIGUOUS (same name/symbol across markets or entities) or is NOT a company, the tool returns `needs_confirmation` — follow its `_guide`. NOT for ETF/commodity/bond/crypto — no company financials.
tickers.title: Tickers
